d.d: Any of several evergreen plants of the genus Yucca, having long, pointed, and rigid leaves at the top of a woody stem, and bearing a large panicle of showy white blossoms.
Uttered to indicate disgust usually toward an objectionable taste or odour.
d.x: Yuck! This peanut butter is disgusting!

d.d: The sound made by a whole-hearted laugh.
Of something highly offensive; causing aversion or disgust.
d.x: The food that I ate today was very yucky.
